Subject: Skyline: proposed metered-billing cutover & DocuSign amendment

Hi Emma,

Great to speak earlier — thanks for the time. Per our call, Skyline is a strong candidate to move billing from the existing direct invoice to the Azure Marketplace metered SKU we published last quarter. The move will preserve your seat/commit pricing and simplify procurement for future expansions.

High-level proposed plan:
- Target cutover weekend: June 8-9, 2028 (minimal API churn)
- Preserve current list pricing for 3 months post-cutover, then align to marketplace metered rates (we can honor existing discount through 2028-09-30)
- Redwood will push an amendment (DocuSign) that ties Skyline subscription to the marketplace SKU and updates payment routing to Azure Marketplace billing.

Can you confirm: who is our procurement contact for the amendment, and whether Skyline requires a PO before DocuSign signature? If you prefer, we can send the amendment to procurement directly.

Attaching an internal sketch of the migration timeline for your review — this is a draft. If this looks ok, I’ll route the formal amendment (redwood_amendment_draft.docx) for legal and then send the DocuSign link.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
(h) 415-555-0198 | hannah_schmitt@redwood.com

Attachment: Skyline_MA_plan_v2.pdf (1 page — proposed timeline and risk checklist)

Thanks Hannah — the plan looks reasonable. A few clarifications:

1) Procurement contact: Samir Patel (procurement@skyline.so) — cc'd on this reply. He handles PO and vendor onboarding.
2) PO requirement: We generally need a PO for billing changes that affect our finance systems. We can sign the amendment once Procurement has the paperwork, but we'd like Redwood to confirm that no changes to service SLAs or entitlements are introduced in the marketplace version.
3) Cost parity: Can you confirm the effective unit price and whether the usage reporting will match our existing exports?

If you can send the draft amendment and the expected pricing table, I'll get Samir to flag anything finance needs. We are targeting the first full week of June for internal change freeze — if cutover still looks like June 8-9, I'll escalate to my ops team.

—Emma
